description: MapEngine opens TMX/XML, installs empty EntityResolver, parses tilesets, layers and tile properties.
Embedded base64 images are deduplicated into TilesetImageCacheEntry and loaded by generated [EMBED] keys.
TMX tile properties set water/cliff/lava/block-building flags and optional tile variants.
MapTile instances are assigned short registered ids for layer tile arrays.
Tileset source rects are scanned for alpha and packed into full-scale or alpha TileAtlas images with padded edges.
Layer tiles resolve registered MapTile objects and draw via TileAtlas source rects / direct image fallback.
Dirty world-space regions are mapped to cache regions and redrawn/shifted as camera scale and origin change.
Terrain flags feed movement cost maps; MapEngine smooth fog atlas uses tile atlas style source rect helpers.
